lines: Come along, dear. It's time for your new eyes.

lines: There we are, dear. All finished. Come and meet me upstairs.

lines: Those buttons weren't a gift, dear. They were how I claimed your soul.

lines: You aren't a living child to me any longer. I will feed on what remains of your life.

lines: And now there's nothing left for you to do. I think I'll keep what's left of you.
mother_4d82080348d9a6ae.direction: Quiet, watchful and controlled; a pointed warning, not shouted.

lines: There. Now everyone has a drink. What a thoughtful host you're becoming.

lines: Hold it steady, sweetheart. Now click each empty glass.

lines: That's our cider jug. We'll top up everyone's glasses after the first course.

lines: The bowl smells of warm honey and summer flowers. What do you think I put in it?

lines: A sharp, fruity scent rises from the bowl, with little purple berry stains at the rim.

lines: The sauce smells of rich cocoa. There are tiny chocolate shavings on the spoon.

lines: Save some room! We'll serve dessert after our little recipe game.

lines: A slice of berry cake for me, please.
mother_7931bd385965424e.direction: Natural, warm and conversational; keep every authored word, with clear unhurried delivery.

lines: Thank you, sweetheart. Don't forget your Other Father.
mother_45461fe113ecbfd6.direction: Natural, warm and conversational; keep every authored word, with clear unhurried delivery.

lines: All tidied away. Stay and chat, or tell us when you're ready to finish.
mother_625fa41d0e6f25fd.direction: Natural, warm and conversational; keep every authored word, with clear unhurried delivery.

lines: How is the first bite? Try the other things on your plate, too.

lines: One more taste. Every dish has a little story behind it.

lines: Is there anything else you would like, sweetheart?

lines: You've smelled the sauce. Which ingredient did you recognise?

lines: Inspect the little recipe bowl first. A good cook uses their nose as well as their eyes.
mother_c3ffe1fb62744db6.direction: Natural, warm and conversational; keep every authored word, with clear unhurried delivery.

lines: Honey for warmth, berries for sharpness, chocolate for a treat. You'll find a recipe bowl on the table when it's time to guess.

lines: What shall we raise our glasses to?

lines: Perfect? Only because I pay attention to what everyone wants. You do tell me what you want, don't you?
mother_89e91dcb58538ad1.direction: Natural, warm and conversational; keep every authored word, with clear unhurried delivery.

lines: Let's enjoy the evening we have first. There is always something else waiting for us.

lines: Exactly right! A fine nose. Now let's get those desserts served.

lines: You found the secret ingredient. Berry cake for me and cookies for your Other Father, please.

lines: Not quite. Smell the recipe bowl again and look for the clue before trying another ingredient.

lines: Taste as you go, and never stop paying attention. The smallest ingredient can change everything.

lines: Of course. A little help can make a meal feel like something we've made together.

lines: To a lovely evening. Just your plate left to clear, sweetheart.

lines: To adventures. Though do remember to come back for supper.
